# The line coverage floor for each type that decides access (#80).
#
# One type per line: the name as a cobertura report spells it, and the percentage
# below which .github/scripts/refuse-coverage-below-the-floor.sh refuses. Nothing
# outside this list is judged, which is the point: a number over the whole
# assembly is mostly a measure of how much boilerplate it has.
#
# Every number here is the value MEASURED when the floor was introduced, rounded
# down to a whole percent, and not a value anybody chose. The command that
# produced them is in #80 along with the reading. Raising one is a decision to
# take deliberately after a measurement, in the same way; lowering one is a
# decision to stop judging something that used to hold.
#
# The measured value for a type is the lowest line rate across its own entry and
# the entries the compiler writes for its async methods, so a floor of 100 means
# every one of those is at 100.

# The token path. Nothing here is bigger than it looks, and all of it is total,
# so anything under full coverage is a routine nobody called.
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareTokens 100
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareTokenHash 100
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareLookup 100

# The store, and the record it holds. ShareStore is the one type here that meets
# a real filesystem, and its floor is the lowest of its own rate and those of the
# state machines its async methods become.
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareStore 78
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareStoreExtensions 100
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareRecord 100

# The decision, and what a guest may do once it has been made.
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareResolution 100
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.ShareResolutionResult 81
Jellyfin.Plugin.ShareLinks.GuestPolicy 100
